tagline: Simplifies IT, guiding the connection between people and technology
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross billings is the best indicator of CNXN's underlying business momentum, as it captures all transactions, including those accounted for on a net basis, and reflects the strength of its multi-vendor distribution model and integrated services.

kpis.name: Gross Billings
kpis.explanation: Total value of billed product and service sales, net of customer returns, credits, and applicable sales taxes.
kpis.description: Gross billings reached $4,134.1 million in 2025, driven by the Enterprise Solutions and Business Solutions segments.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in total business volume in 2025

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue recognized after accounting adjustments, excluding certain transactions accounted for on a net basis.
kpis.description: Net sales amounted to $2,872.7 million in 2025, an increase of $70.6 million compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Moderate but stable net revenue growth

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 18.8% in 2025, driven by more profitable deals and higher software sales on a net basis.
kpis.signal: Ongoing gross margin improvement driven by services and software

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by net sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin remained stable at 3.5% in both 2024 and 2025, despite investments in services and IT systems.

kpis.name: R&D
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development to create and enhance IT solutions.
kpis.description: R&D expenses are not explicitly disclosed as a separate line item in the 10-K or 8-K filings.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth and operations.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are not detailed in the provided 10-K excerpts.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount is not mentioned in the provided 10-K excerpts.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.35 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Gross Billings
kpis.explanation: Total value of billed product and service sales, net of customer returns, credits, and applicable sales taxes.
kpis.description: Gross billings grew by 2.7% in 2025, following +1.4% in 2024, driven by the Enterprise Solutions and Business Solutions segments.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved over three years, rising from 18.0% in 2023 to 18.8% in 2025, supported by software sales and higher-value-added services.
kpis.signal: Ongoing margin improvement driven by services and software

risks.title: Cash flow volatility and working capital cycle management
risks.score_rationale: Operating cash flow decreased by $108.4 million in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to changes in inventory and accounts receivable. This volatility affects the ability to fund operations and investments.

risks.title: Inventory growth and working capital financing
risks.score_rationale: Inventory increased by $48.5 million in 2025, reflecting significant customer rollouts. This increase absorbs operating cash flow and impacts liquidity.

risks.title: Direct competition risks from manufacturers
risks.score_rationale: Several major manufacturers (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft, etc.) are attempting to sell directly to customers, threatening CNXN's value-added distributor position.

risks.title: Exposure to AI market uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The AI market remains difficult to predict. CNXN must invest significantly to remain competitive while managing risks related to AI products sold.

risks.title: Inflationary pressure on product and labor costs
risks.score_rationale: Inflation affects product costs and wages. CNXN may struggle to pass through these increases to customers without impacting demand.

risks.title: Dependence on public sector demand
risks.score_rationale: The Public Sector Solutions segment represents 18% of sales ($755.2 million in 2025). A government shutdown could reduce public orders.

risks.title: Interest rate uncertainty and financing costs
risks.score_rationale: Although the Fed lowered rates in 2025, the future path remains uncertain. Any financing needs would expose CNXN to potentially higher rates.

risks.title: Impact of tariffs on product costs
risks.score_rationale: If suppliers pass through tariffs to CNXN, it could affect operating results and competitiveness.

ai_positioning.summary: PC Connection recognizes the growing importance of AI in its business and refers to AI as an advanced technology category. The company highlights that the AI market continues to evolve and that significant investments may be required to remain competitive, while managing risks associated with AI products sold.
evidence: Item 1 Business: The company lists AI among its broad range of IT solutions including hardware, software, and services
Item 7 MD&A: Discussion of AI challenges, including the need to invest to keep pace with competition and manage product risks
